scientific_scope_status: At an actual baseline mu, known visible normalized input 0<=f<=B and stable mu-reversible operation calls, three chronological forward echoes acquire D=||rho_u-rho_v||_L2(mu)^2. Every common later causal receiver on the included full physical state obeys TV<=min(1,sqrt(D)/2), including new interventions and arbitrarily long well-defined later records. A reverse-word randomized witness has gap D/(2B). No finite predictive closure is required.
